responsibility: Declares the public helpers associated with High-to-Low GIMPLE lowering, including queries for whether a statement or sequence may fall through and routines for recording local variables into the current function or an arbitrary function during lowering and related setup.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the public helper declarations associated with lowering, such as fallthrough queries and variable-recording routines, while the .cc file implements the lowering pass itself and its builtin/return transformation logic.
